doesNotAssert: signer leadership is held by this instance

READINESS_CHECKS.asserts: the primary database answers a health query
doesNotAssert: signer leadership is held by this instance

READINESS_CHECKS.asserts: the boot key-ring is loaded and the vault census is verified
doesNotAssert: signer leadership is held by this instance
a specific wallet lease is owned

READINESS_CHECKS.asserts: a validated gateway read succeeded inside the configured failure budget
doesNotAssert: signer leadership is held by this instance

READINESS_CHECKS.asserts: reporting restore_hold is false for this node (or no restore_hold row exists yet)
doesNotAssert: signer leadership is held by this instance
lifecycle auth_hold is clear on every head

READINESS_CHECKS.asserts: this instance currently holds the single process-wide signer leadership lock
doesNotAssert: the node is ready to serve read and admin traffic
a wallet may be signed for without its own C-02 lease

supersedes_draft_clauses: node-core draft: readiness is false until signer leadership is held by exactly one instance
operations-recovery draft boot step: report readiness only when exactly one signer leader is active
operations-recovery draft degraded mode: readiness is false when the signer is unavailable
RECONCILIATION.resolution: readiness gates on schema, database, vault, observation, and restore_hold_clear; signer_leadership is a reported non-gating check
RECONCILIATION.reason: coupling readiness to leadership re-introduces the overlap-deploy deadlock the decoupling rule fixed

supersedes_draft_clauses: prior shell: restore_hold is admission-only and /health/ready stays 200 under a held restore
RESTORE_HOLD_READINESS.resolution: restore_hold_clear is a gating readiness check; a held restore forces /health/ready 503 while money-path four-mode partition is unchanged
RESTORE_HOLD_READINESS.reason: a green ready on a node that refuses every implementer request misleads orchestrators and dashboards
does_not_gate: lifecycle auth_hold (admission conjunction remains restore_hold ∧ auth_hold)

FAIL_CLOSED_RULES.rule: a signing path is permitted only when this instance holds signer leadership
a leadership claim is permitted only after the vault census has verified
losing leadership mid-operation quiesces signing and engines and never releases or re-sequences wallet leases
leadership is a node-level writer role; the wallet sequencing authority remains the C-02 universal lease
graceful shutdown withdraws signer authority and quiesces engines and in-flight signing before releasing the leadership lock, releasing it last so a successor never signs concurrently
a leadership lock lost involuntarily (connection loss or database failover) stops signing and money engines immediately and restarts to re-acquire; it never continues signing after loss
